name: krystals-flower-kreations
description: Krystal's Flower Kreations — paper florist & armature art workshop (Perth WA). Cricut + origami shop, blog, POS & workshop platform.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint; cd ../frontend && npm run lint
